answer: Because the shale weight is recomputed from the haven history each close, the beacon audit makes public the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm as a result buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 7 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 24% of full weight. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
